title: Imaging protocol suggested by large language model depends on language: preliminary experiments using GPT-4

live_model.evidence: "We used the latest model...namely GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-05-13)"; "The scores for the sequences proposed by GPT were 27/40 points in English and 28/40 points in Japanese"

prompt.location: "System prompt for GPT-4" quoted in full in the Methods section
prompt.note: Only the disease name was sent as the user prompt; temperature=0.0.

claim.metric: expert score (0-2 per case, summed), English
claim.location: Results: "scores for the sequences proposed by GPT were 27/40 points in English"; 20 disease names, max 2 pts each

data.source: 20 brain-MRI disease names (standard neuroradiology conditions); full GPT responses provided as a supplementary Excel sheet

notes: Scored 0/1/2 by two radiologists with 20+ years' experience (human judge). The Japanese-language run gives 28/40 with a different pattern of inappropriate cases (Moyamoya disease, neuromyelitis optica, plus cerebral infarction in Japanese only).
